messages:
anya: quick q — are we leaning proto-first for internal APIs or OpenAPI-first? thinking about client-codegen, gateway transcoding, and telemetry.

mike: proto-first from me. strong contracts, better codegen for server+clients, smaller wire format, and streaming with gRPC is a win for long-lived connections.

sam: openapi-first is more approachable for product and infra teams that use curl/postman. also easier to hand off to QA — autogenerated examples are handy.

olivia: gateway/transcoding complexity is the sticking point. envoy's grpc-json-transcoder can work but we hit weirdness around oneof/enum mapping and nested messages last time.

mike: we could standardize patterns: core services proto-first, then produce an OpenAPI shim (generated) for external REST clients. keeps contracts tight without blocking consumers.

sam: how does this impact rollouts/console UX? We want to show routes in the console and attach quotas/alerts regardless of transport.

anya: telemetry question — when we do transcoding, how do we preserve tenant/auth metadata so metrics and cost attribution remain accurate?

tia: put tenant/token into x- headers at the edge and have the transcoder pass them through. also mirror into span attributes in the ingress tracer.

olivia: add to that: Envoy doesn't preserve original path by default when transcoding, so add x-original-path to help routing and dashboards.

mike: example envoy filter config we used as a starting point:
```yaml
http_filters:
- name: envoy.filters.http.grpc_json_transcoder
  typed_config:
    "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.grpc_json_transcoder.v3.GrpcJsonTranscoder
    proto_descriptor: /etc/envoy/protos.pb
    services: ["api.v1.Model"]
    print_options:
      add_whitespace: true
```

olivia: and a minimal proto sketch for context:
```protobuf
syntax = "proto3";
package api.v1;
message PredictRequest { string model = 1; string prompt = 2; }
message PredictResponse { string text = 1; }
service Model { rpc Predict(PredictRequest) returns (PredictResponse); }
```

sam: schema evolution concerns — proto gives us reserved/tag hygiene which is nice. OpenAPI tends to encourage breaking reshapes over time unless we enforce strict practices.

anya: tooling question: JS/web teams prefer OpenAPI client generators. can we add a build step to generate OpenAPI from proto (grpc-gateway / protoc-gen-openapiv2) so console/docs/client bundles are generated automatically?

olivia: we've used protoc-gen-openapiv2 before — it works but we need linting for edge cases (maps, oneofs). automation + tests should catch the odd mappings.

mike: ops note — for latency-sensitive endpoints, prefer native gRPC paths (no transcoder) in Dedicated mode; reserve transcoding for compatibility routes.

anya: proposal summary: proto-first for internal core services; generate OpenAPI artifacts for docs/client bundles; provide an automated gateway/transcoder template + recommended headers (x-original-path, x-tenant-id); console will surface transport type and unified route metrics.

sam: +1 :thumbsup:

olivia: +1 — add a checklist for proto->openapi CI checks.

tia: noted — will draft an infra ticket for templating the envoy config.

deploy-bot: created INFRA-412: add proto->openapi generation to build pipeline and provide envoy transcoder template (assigned to tia).
